snippet.title: Terminus: Zombie Survivors – Last Escape DLC Launch Trailer | Turn-based Survival Roguelike Game
snippet.description:
➤ STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3550310/Terminus_Zombie_Survivors__Last_Escape/?utm_source=YouTube

The survival journey continues in Terminus: Zombie Survivors – Last Escape, the game’s first major DLC, now officially released!

After reaching the Terminus, supplies are dwindling and the undead threat grows stronger. In this story-driven expansion, you’ll meet new survivors, explore the depths of the Terminus station, and take on quests that reveal hidden stories. Gather your strength, restore the railway, and fight for a daring train escape in the ultimate test of survival.

Join the community and stay updated:
➤ Discord: https://discord.com/invite/AaTZCeS4vh
➤ X: https://x.com/LongplayStudios
➤ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@TerminusZombieSurvivors

Video Details:
Terminus: Zombie Survivors – Last Escape DLC Launch Trailer | Turn-based Survival Roguelike Game
https://youtu.be/iPC5vdcLX8I

#terminuszombiesurvivors #lasescape #dlc #survivalgame #roguelike #zombiesurvival #turnbased

터미너스: 좀비 생존자들의 "마지막 탈출 DLC"가 드디어 정식 출시되었습니다!

종착역에 도착한 뒤에도 생존의 여정은 끝나지 않았습니다. 식량과 자원이 고갈되고 좀비의 위협은 점점 커져만 갑니다. 스토리 중심의 확장팩에서 새로운 생존자들을 만나고, 종착역 내부를 탐험하며 숨겨진 이야기를 밝혀내세요. 힘을 모아 철도를 복구하고, 승강장을 되찾아 기차 탈출을 향한 최후의 도전에 도전하세요.

커뮤니티에 가입해 최신 정보를 받아보세요:
➤ Discord: https://discord.com/invite/AaTZCeS4vh
➤ X: https://x.com/LongplayStudios
➤ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@TerminusZombieSurvivors
